title: Weak key drill
summary: Two minutes on whichever keys you personally keep missing, now that you have all of them.
intro: No fixed content again. The course has been counting your mistakes through the whole unit, and it builds this drill out of the keys you get wrong most often — which after Unit 2 is usually one of the bottom-row reaches or a little finger doing something it resents. Two minutes here is worth more than another lesson on the keys you already have.
congrats: Weak keys stay weak by being avoided, and there is no way to avoid one in a drill built entirely out of it. Next is the test, and it is the same one minute you typed at the end of Unit 1 — a straight comparison.

screens.text: Two minutes, drawn from your own worst keys. There is no end of the text to reach, so spend the time on accuracy rather than on finishing.
